subject: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@acmecorp.com>, Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Jordan / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our kickoff and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. Let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of pain points you shared
- Latency spikes during peak search flows (95th pct > 800ms) causing visible UX issues
- Cost per query is rising with current model footprint; looking to reduce token spend without quality regressions
- Internal ops complexity: many model variants and no standardized rollout process for prompt updates

POC objective and success metrics
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference as a drop-in replacement for the current search reranking pipeline with 1) equal-or-better relevance, 2) <300ms median latency at 99qps, and 3) >=30% reduction in cost per query (token/billing).
- Primary metrics: relevance (NDCG@10 on provided eval set), tail latency (p95), cost per 1k queries.

Scope / Deliverables for the 4-week POC
1) Data & prompt set: Redwood will run initial evals on the prompt set you shared (we'll expand to 1k queries). Rishi will own prompt engineering and eval harness.
2) Integration & infra: Monica will help with access to a test AWS account and network setup; we'll deploy a dedicated test endpoint.
3) Baselines & reporting: Marissa will coordinate weekly metric reviews and a final findings doc.
4) Rollout plan: If POC targets are met, we propose a 6-week staged rollout (can discuss SLA/commit).

Immediate next steps (owners & timing)
- Jordan/Sarah: Share sample prompt set, 1k queries + expected labels by EOD Wednesday (May 5). (Owner: Acme)
- Monica (Redwood): Share AWS onboarding checklist and IAM roles; provide a short runbook for test endpoint by Tue May 4. (Owner: Monica)
- Rishi (Redwood): Validate prompt set, submit initial eval results within 3 business days of receiving data. (Owner: Rishi)
- Marissa (Redwood): Weekly syncs starting May 6; schedule invite for recurring Tuesday 10am PT. (Owner: Marissa)

Access/setup notes
- Attached: acme-poc-scope.pdf (scope & timeline), prompt-set-template.csv, access-instructions.md.
- Please whitelist the following IPs on your test environment: 54.12.34.56, 54.12.34.57

Risks / open questions
- Will Acme be able to provide labeled data for NDCG computation, or do you want Redwood to run a blind rerank and compare against click-derived signals?
- Any specific compliance constraints for the test account (data retention or logging)?

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: acme-poc-scope.pdf, prompt-set-template.csv, access-instructions.md

From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@acmecorp.com>

Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and matches what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) For the labeled data: we can provide a 500-query labeled set for initial NDCG scoring and a larger 5k clickstream-derived set for cost/latency comparisons. We'll upload the labeled set by Wed EOD.
2) For compliance: the test account must not retain query text beyond 30 days; we can provide a PIN if needed for short-lived access.

I've looped in Sarah who will be our engineering lead on the integration side (cc'd). Monica — can you send over the IAM role template and estimated time to spin up the test endpoint?

Jordan
Jordan Meyers
Director, Search Engineering | Acme Corp
jordan.meyers@acmecorp.com
+1 (202) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@acmecorp.com>, Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap & next steps

Appreciate the quick responses — good plan on the labeled + clickstream sets. Two quick notes: 

- Retention: We can set the test endpoint to not persist raw query text (we'll only store hashes for debugging) and enforce a 30-day retention window. Monica, I'll need a confirmation once you've provisioned the test account.
- Rishi will take point on the prompt/eval work. Rishi — can you confirm you'll run NDCG@10 & precision@5 on the 500 labeled queries and share the initial report within 3 business days of receiving the set?

I will schedule the recurring sync for Tue 10am PT starting May 6 and share a calendar invite (recurrence: weekly). If there are any conflicts, please flag them here.

Thanks — moving fast which is great.

Best,
Marissa

On a separate note: Jordan, if you want to accelerate the infra side we can open a temporary dedicated endpoint on our side and do a proxy integration while your team sets up the test account — this usually shaves 2-3 days off the timeline. Let me know if you want that option and I'll have Monica stand that up.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
